HavenOS.Apps.Data.DuckDbDatabaseEngine still defaults to pythonExecutable="python3", so until the package installs into a bundled interpreter directory and the engine points at it, a build could still resolve a user-site duckdb. The lock and tests make that a visible defect instead of an invisible fallback.
Only cp312 is locked because that is this PC's interpreter; a different interpreter needs its own resolved lock rather than silently reusing this one.
The failure-mode tests (missing dependency, wrong version, wrong ABI, corrupt wheel bytes, offline startup, x64 and ARM64 worker launch) are still to be written.
